== Description ==

[[Brian Fred]] (left foreground) and [[Greg Shaw]] (right) in their semifinal, with [[Logan Pietig]] (seated, back) and [[Amar Banger]] (standing, olive hoodie and beard) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025.
